name: Yamakaze Momoka
source:
Hobby: Shopping
Likes: Genzo's cooking
Dislikes: spending on new weapons
She formed Gaitherd because his father's murderer has not been brought to justice and is trying to do even more evil.
She is obsessed with avenging his father's death.
She is calm and single-minded, but in the morning he is in a daze.
She is in charge of weapons development within the organization.

Shuffle ~Bokura wa Omoi o Tokihanatsu~ Proflie

She formed Gai-Zard to avenge his father's murder, Hokuto.
She is calm and single-minded, but in the mornings, she is a bit of a daze.
She was obsessed with avenging his father.
